about_the_game:
You can select your player attack speed! this will change drastically your game experience! Which will you choose? the most slower or the most fast? choose any! and enjoy the 3 speed modes of the Game!!!

(The most fast will give you certain advantage, while the most slower will give you a more paused and durable gameplay experience)
